title: Longhorn PHP 2023
content:
Hosted in Austin, Texas, Longhorn PHP is back for its fifth year! This year's conference will be start with an optional tutorial day on Thursday, November 2, with main conference days on Friday and Saturday, November 3-4.

Longhorn PHP is a regional conference designed to help PHP developers level up their craft and connect with the larger PHP community. Our , with Early Bird pricing available through the end of September.full schedule is available now
